summary.intent: Create and commit the 25-03 SUMMARY file for the desktop enhancements phase, following the existing summary format from 25-01.
summary.outcome: The 25-03 SUMMARY.md was written, committed, and ROADMAP.md was updated to reflect 25-03 progress.

repo: Summary files for phases follow a naming convention: {phase-number}-SUMMARY.md under .planning/phases/{phase-folder}/
The 25-01 SUMMARY was used as a template/reference for creating the 25-03 SUMMARY
workflow: ROADMAP.md is updated after each phase summary is created to track plan progress
Each phase summary is committed immediately after creation
